fact: The DHIS2 for Education profile for Eswatini is subtitled 'Aggregate and individual EMIS data connected to national identity', and describes the EMIS (aggregate) and SEMIS App (individual learner and staff data, PIN-based) as national in scale since a 2020 pilot.
system: DHIS2 for Education (EMIS and SEMIS App)

fact: The document says Eswatini's EMIS is driven by the Personal Identity Number, with individual-level learner and staff records, since national launch in March 2024 across all 976 primary and secondary schools; schools still submit PINs manually on claim forms for validation against Home Affairs records at regional offices, to be automated with SEMIS.
